entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into this for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
A preference issue? They're defective! They're giving me massive blisters on every ride! I've adjusted the cleats, I've tried everything, and they're just torture to wear. They're garbage!

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Can I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Sarah Jenkins. The order number is VF-8675309. You'd better not give me the runaround on this. I want a refund, and I want it now. If not, I'm talking to a manager.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered 64 days ago.
And? Don't tell me I'm past some ridiculous 30-day window. For the price I paid, these should last for years, not cause injuries. I will light you up on every review site if you deny this.

Not at all, ma'am. I was just confirming the date. Standard items like your shoes fall under our 10-day return policy. Since you received them 64 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can definitely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh. A full refund? Seriously? You're not going to fight me on it?

No, there's no need for that. You're within the policy, and we want to make it right. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Okay. Well... that's actually... good. I expected a whole thing. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
